## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New capability, transport, or UI panel
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix or corrective refinement
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates or additions
- [ ] `refactor`: Code or structure refinement without behavioral changes
- [ ] `test`: New or updated Vitest unit tests
- [ ] `ci`: GitHub Actions or automation changes
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling or dependency updates
